description: This file defines the PageCache class implementing HTTP kernel interface for Drupal's page caching middleware, handling cache lookup, storage, and response policies.

classes.name: PageCache
classes.description: Implements page caching middleware for Drupal, managing cache retrieval, storage, and response policies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PageCache object with kernel, cache, and policy interfaces.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, serving from cache or passing to backend based on request policy.

methods.name: pass
methods.description: Forwards request directly to the backend kernel, bypassing cache.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Retrieves response from cache or fetches from backend, handling cache validation and revalidation.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches response from backend and stores it in cache if allowed.

methods.name: storeResponse
methods.description: Stores a response in cache if it meets cacheability policies.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores response in cache with expiration and tags.

methods.name: getCacheId
methods.description: Generates a cache ID based on request data.
